response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.a FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.a > b.base) SELECT k.rfistat, k.a AS avg_modindex, k.a - b.base AS above_baseline, k.a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN b

assumptions.assumption: Signals with a NULL rfistat form one group, shown with a NULL status. Empty-string values are not treated as missing.
A status whose modindex values are all NULL has a NULL average. It is left out of the baseline and cannot be kept.
